'''Dorn Base''' was an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and successive [[Galactic War]]. The base included a [[command center]], an Imperial market, and a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Vannis]] was the base's commander before being killed in action around [[3642 BBY]].
